'''January 2001 Ithaca tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ithaca, NY on 27 January 2001. [[Brian Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1674">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-ithaca-ny-27-jan-01d1674/ ithaca-ny-27-jan-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-ithaca-ny-27-jan-01d1674/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Ithaca, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]
